starforce.source: MapleStory Wiki, Star Force Enhancement (GMS column); v.271 notes (Star Catch bonus now always on, updated 29 Sep 2026); v.269 notes (Safeguard and Enhancement Mode). Checked 23 Nov 2026.
starforce.costNote: Cost per attempt = 1000 + L^3 x f(star), rounded to the nearest 100, with L the item level rounded down to 10. f = (star+1)/25 below 10 stars, else (star+1)^2.7 / divisor.
starforce.restoreNote: A destroyed item leaves a trace that keeps flames and potential; restoring it gives these stars.

safeguard.note: Safeguard covers attempts at 15, 16 and 17 stars and adds 200% of the base cost; event discounts don't reduce that surcharge.

sunny.note: Sunny Sunday Star Force days: 30% off (multiplies with MVP) and 30% less destruction for attempts at 21 stars or below. GMS has run these about every two weeks.

mvp.note: MVP discounts apply to every attempt from 0 stars up to the 16 to 17 star attempt. Not confirmed for Heroic worlds.

cubes.source: Prices: MapleStory Wiki, Heroic Cube Shop (edited 26 Mar 2026). Tier-up odds: community estimates (gms-upgrade-tracker changelog, 1 Nov 2026); Nexon doesn't publish GMS cube odds, so edit them if you trust other figures.

bright.name: Bright Cube
bright.note: Pick the old or new result each time.

cubes.heroicNoBonus: Bonus potential cubes are Interactive-only, so Heroic gear has no bonus potential to work on.

potential.source: Line values: MapleStory Wiki, Potential (GMS level bands: items Lv. 151+ roll 13% Legendary stat lines). Meso and Item Drop lines are Legendary accessory lines (face, eye, earrings, rings, pendants). Values are editable for anything unusual.

exp.source: MapleStory Wiki, Experience/Leveling Tables (edited 11 Sep 2026); 260+ matches KMS per Maplerhouse. EXP needed to go from each level to the next.
exp.gatesSource: Angler Company 270 and Nightmare Paradise 280: MapleStory Wiki, Epic Dungeon pages (read 27 Nov 2026). Mayrin 270 and Hard Mayrin 280: Nexon's Challenger World notice (47305). Sol Erda held: Nexon v.272 patch notes (47132).
exp.gatesNote: The third part of a gate is about Challenger World (Item Burning Plus and the season boss Mayrin, Nexon notice 47305); it is shown only to a Challenger World character while the season runs (ibp.json endsAt). The fourth part is about Beyond Burning; it is shown only to a character that has it, while it runs.
exp.beyondBurningNote: Beyond Burning gives one extra level per level-up until 280, so only every other level costs EXP.

erda.source: HEXA Matrix Origin costs from the MapleStory Wiki. The weekly default is Erda's Request: 9 Sol Erda a week in GMS (MapleStory Wiki, Sol Erda page, read 27 Nov 2026); the 90 Fragments a week is a player-reported figure, not confirmed by Nexon.
erda.holdCapSource: Most Sol Erda a character can hold, by level: Nexon v.272 patch notes (news 47132, read 27 Nov 2026), Item Changes. Sol Erda above it cannot be used.
